# Scope – Base Game and Expansion

## Base Game

The base game includes:

- awakening in the Hero's Chamber;
- introduction of the Talisman;
- several restorable levels;
- the complete progression from landscape to abilities;
- revelation of the artificial Shard World;
- the endgame return and gathering of Soul Energy;
- escape from the Constructed World;
- three World Passages;
- a boss battle against Jator;
- a subsequent boss battle against Semm;
- conclusion of the sixth chapter, or the first major part of the hero's story.

## Not Part of the Base Game

- a full war against all major Ether Entities;
- a definitive explanation of every sphere within Hera;
- the hero's transformation into an Ether Entity;
- the hero's physical return to Era;
- an answer concerning his later role on Era.

## Expansion

The expansion includes:

- conflict with the remaining major Ether Entities;
- travel through additional spheres of Hera;
- the gradual transformation of the hero's form of existence;
- his own transformation into an Ether Entity;
- the possibility of returning physically to Era;
- a deliberately open ending.

## Scope Risk

The world concept is substantially larger than a single game. Production must therefore limit the base game to the number of levels needed to carry restoration, attachment, revelation, and reversal convincingly. The entire cosmology does not need to be traversed in full.
